description:
Fact, measured on fz-sc8/distill-fz at 864b7dbd1:

    def f(t) when tuple_size(t) == 0, do: :empty
    def f(_), do: :other
    def main(), do: dbg(f({}))

- interp: "fz2 interp: backend clause dispatch required omitted semantic input 0"
- run: error[artifact/incomplete-semantic-plan] "native clause dispatch required omitted semantic input 0 for executable 50"
- Elixir prints :empty.

The argument `{}` is zero-width, so its semantic input is omitted from the executable, but the guard still reads it. The dispatch plan and the omitted-input decision disagree about whether the guard is a reader. Found by the fz-sc8.9 builder; it predates fz-sc8.9 for any guard over a zero-width input.
title: An entry guard that reads only an empty tuple fails to compile
